author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be more laws when it comes to verifying how old you are on your own computer. The future looks bleak when it comes to our privacy and safety but it's not too late to fight back. Call your representatives and tell them you don't want your computer infested with age verification. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: please fight back we are almost out of time...
